quests.title: Wanmin Fresh

dialogue.sit: I have other things to do.

dialogue.t: Alright. Let's see, who else can enter Jueyun Karst as they please, I wonder...
Please take care while traveling to Jueyun Karst. Don't fly about or climb any way you like, or I fear that we might anger the adepti.
Don't touch any strange elements, either, or you'll ruin the taste.

dialogue.section: Deliver the food to Laid Back Ling'guan

dialogue.sit: I heard that someone placed a custom order...

dialogue.t: A guest named Ling'guan ordered some Come And Get It from us, mentioning that it should be delivered to Jueyun Karst at a later time.
As if Jueyun Karst was a border that ordinary mortals could trespass!
Ahem. Well, whatever the case, could you help us deliver this order to Jueyun Karst? Let's see if we can get it there in time.
Oh, you're here at last. Thanks a lot!
Why, eating this makes me feel luckier already.

quests.description: Wanmin Restaurant has taken a custom order that now awaits delivery...
